svg.title: Ascension — festomanolo
svg.desc: A platformer built from festomanolo's last year on GitHub: 53 weeks become towers whose windows are days. The Punished God crosses them, gathers 23,601 souls, slays 10 demons and defeats The Darkness at Heaven's Gate.

g.text: FROM THE ABYSS TO THE GATE
it was there before our creation.”
AND SO THE PILGRIMAGE BEGINS AGAIN
